quests.instruction: Listen carefully, then select the word you hear.
quests.hint: After the /b/, touch your tongue tip behind your teeth for 'blink'; curl it back for 'brink.'
quests.explanation: The speaker said "blink." The /l/ touches the ridge behind the teeth. "Brink" would curl the tongue back for /r/ instead.
quests.vowelTensionRule: The first consonant and the vowel stay the same — only the second sound in the cluster changes. /l/ taps the ridge behind the teeth; /r/ pulls back without touching.
